Gene Enrichment Analysis

(A) Functional protein interactome for genes with de novo variants in all subjects with placental malperfusion (n = 41 genes) and without placental malperfusion (n = 46 genes) subjected to K-means clustering demonstrate distinct pathway enrichment. Circles and nodes are query proteins. Edges represent layers of evidence of protein–protein associations. False discovery rate P value is listed next to each pathway enriched. (B) Gene set enrichment analysis with the top 10 enriched terms in each library displayed based on the −log10(P value). Actual P value displayed next to each term. The term at the top has the most significant overlap with the gene set. *Adjusted P < 0.05. Abbreviation as in Figure 2
